verdict.rationale: Runpod's docs state that the Runpod CLI (runpodctl) is open source, so part of the product's tooling has readable source. Nothing in the evidence shows the core GPU cloud platform, Serverless, or API services are source-available, and no specific license or repository is named. missing for 10: open-source release of the core platform, a named open license, a link to a public source repository, independent corroboration.
